| 清单声明 Node >=24.9.0 与 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、<0.3.0-0 | 必需 | 加载宿主和客户端产物 | 范围外兼容未核实 |

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | 临时 profile 与独立备份的磁盘成本未知 | 核对包名、会话动作和浏览器 | 清单版本属于声明 |
| 持续 | 按消息扫描已跟踪集合及保存变化副本，增量资源未知 | 确认预览、回执和 Git 差异 | 单会话窗口有限，实际空间和延迟未测 |
| 失败恢复 | 保留 Git 或外部基线 | 按文件比对、辩明缺失版本或跳过 | 命令成功可能仍留未恢复文件 |
| 退出 | 可能要另行管理本地快照 | 保存必要上下文，停用插件回到原工作流 | 会话原日志仍能含撤回内容 |

| 同窗退回 | 按真实用户消息设定替换后缀 | 多种宿主部署下的实际投影和回填 |
| 文件恢复 | 已跟踪且符合路径约束的文件可逐项恢复 | 外部写入和中断下的覆盖率 |
| Firefox 可操作性 | 确认越界后根据按钮位置修正 | 实际版本、缩放和窄窗下的可点击性 |

[Q01](#research-q01) 使用同一条真实用户消息划定对话退回边界并回填草稿，[Q02](#research-q02) 可用消息检查点恢复已跟踪文件。[Q03](#research-q03) 的 Firefox 兜底只在测得面板越界时介入。

[Q04](#research-q04) 提出把对话、文件和草稿结果显示为三个可检查的状态。用缺失备份和同大小旧时间戳作对照，验证是否能降低开发者的误续写率。

business.rationale: 流程 50%：[Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q02](#research-q02) 缩短退回指令、重新编辑及逐文件回退准备。交付 25%：窗口给出可继续的对话和部分文件回执，未改变最终软件交付。触达 0%：[Q03](#research-q03) 的校正改善 Firefox 可点击性，未证实新增用户群可以使用；宿主及快照前提相同。成本结构 0%：省掉部分手工选提示动作，用户仍承担备份和验证，未见资源责任改变。

recommendation.reason: 在 DSH Web 中反复修改实现指令的开发者，可以先在临时会话试一次只撤回对话。它比另开会话再复制提示多保留了原窗口，并能在符合条件时把指令带回输入框。如果命令失败、草稿未回来或文件差异与预览不符，就暂停续写，按需从原日志找回提示并用独立备份核对工作区。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的 src/rewind.ts 213–245 和 src/client/rewind-flow.ts 158–218 指向反复调试实现时重新选择指令与上下文的具体摩擦，超过单有场景的部分档。实际使用强度和采用必要性未知，未到充分。

advantage.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的 src/index.ts 642–660 保留同窗并替换特定投影，无需另开对话继续组织旧上下文；[Q02](#research-q02) 保留文件回退选择。该增量比单纯打开面板更大，外部改动、回填写保护和 Git 文件基线仍限制最高档。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 的 src/index.ts 642–716 可追到实际标记及恢复分支，[Q03](#research-q03) 的 placement-guard.ts 81–118 可追踪 Firefox 兜底，强于入口说明。未执行真实宿主、浏览器及故障路径，因此止于源码档。

cost.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 的 snapshot.ts 351–387 表明工作区需复核，备份占用和失败恢复时间未知。单对话模式有明确退路且文件任务可切回 Git，超过有限档。双模式会出现部分恢复，容错工时需要验证，未到较轻档。

publication.summaries.text: 在同一个 DSH 会话撤回到指定用户消息之前，回填原提示，并可选恢复被跟踪的工作区文件。

items.界面: 在消息行启动回退并按回执回填草稿

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 会话回退 | 从当前投影撤回目标及之后的内容 | 目标必须是当前可见的人类用户消息 |
| 文件检查点及恢复 | 按消息还原已跟踪路径 | 本机可映射的 write 或 edit 路径，可能部分恢复 |
| 影响预览 | 查询候选和可能受影响的文件 | 未跟踪改动与异常文件不能由预览保证 |
| 草稿回填 | 把目标指令带回同一会话 | 等待当前回执，保留现有文字草稿 |
| Firefox 面板校正 | 面板越界时按触发按钮重新定位 | 命中 Firefox 且越界才启动 |

Conversation rewind: a single \"mask\", not a delete\n\n`append-only` is a hard rule: the session log only grows and is never rewritten — the foundation of auditability and privacy. A rewind never touches history; it makes a single move: append **one \"empty message\" marker** to the end of the log and use it to \"mask + replace\" the target message and everything after it, so the model and the UI see only what came before it.\n\n- **One and the same log** — the append happens only in the current session's log: no new session, no new branch, so no residue or copy is left behind;\n- **The marker is canonical** — the same \"hide + replace\" as the official `/compact`: `/compact` compresses a span of history into a summary, while `/rewind` swaps in an \"empty message\" marker. Because it is canonical, DSH's log replay, compaction, and resume preflight all recognize it and never mistake it for a real message;\n- **The replacement is imperceptible** — the model ignores the marker, with no effect (verified empirically). Together with the plugin's UI handling, what you and the model see is exactly how the conversation looked at the target;\n- **Content is preserved** — because this is \"masking, not deleting\", the withdrawn content stays in the log — auditable, traceable, and in principle manually recoverable.\n\n> **Design note**: the entire conversation rewind is **a single append**. It's deterministic, auditable, and — because the log was never broken — a \"clean\" time-travel. Minimal action, complete semantics.\n\n### 2. File restore: partial tracking and lightweight checkpointing\n\nThe file half follows Claude Code's checkpoint semantics — **partial tracking + checkpointing**, not a whole-tree snapshot. This trade-off saves space while still covering changes to tracked files:\n\n- **Partial tracking**: tracks all changes made by DSH's file editing tools (`write`, `edit`) — records the files it first touches and backs up their pre-edit status; it never backs up the whole workspace, so it's lightweight.\n- **Checkpointing**: automatically captures the state of your **tracked files** before each prompt you send that starts a turn. External changes to tracked files such as a command run or a manual edit can be restored by a later rewind.\n- **Unchanged-not-stored**: when checkpointing, an unchanged file is never backed up; the same version from the previous checkpoint is reused instead of a copy.\n- **Accurate restore**: backups are the sole standard, checked against the real disk — **only files that actually differ are touched**. Backups are stored byte for byte, so the restored result matches the backups exactly, with no \"ghost impact\". Coverage is bounded by design: [File-rewind tracking boundary](docs/compat/tracking-boundary.md).\n- **Safety and integrity**: paths are sanitized so nothing ever escapes the backup root; symlinks / hard links are skipped so one restore can't clobber another name of the same file; a per-file failure never aborts the pass; checkpoints and versions are written atomically and kept across restarts, so a target file is never half-written; a crash can be rerun to converge.\n\n> **Design note**: **boundary checkpointing + first-touch capture + version reuse** — the message-boundary checkpoint re-reads every tracked file and records its state; first touch adds a new file with its pre-touch state; restore touches only files that differ. Small on disk and suitable for quick, session-level recoveries.\n\n## Scope and division of labour\n\nThis plugin deliberately stays lightweight and focused on one thing — \"conversation rewind\".
